about: Plan BK Task 6: the reading editions Granger publishes, each a book in the catalog set granger-reading-editions and named by the pack items it replaces (`items`: zimName + manifest key). publish_editions.py copies the EPUBs to an upload folder as <id>.epub, writes the `edition` column of those packs' .gbooks, and puts the set in a catalog. Only titles the rights pass cleared and that aren't out of date (Neal 2026-11-20).

set.title: Granger reading editions
set.description: Whole works rebuilt to read on a phone: chapters, a contents page, pictures sized to the screen, and tables checked against the printed page.

editions.title: Rigging Techniques, Procedures, and Applications
editions.author: US Army (FM 5-125, with Change 1)
editions.description: The Army's manual on rope and rigging: choosing and caring for rope; knots, hitches, lashings and splices, every one with its drawing; hoists, anchors, guy lines and scaffolds.

editions.title: Complete Guide to Home Canning
editions.author: US Department of Agriculture (2015)
editions.description: The USDA's tested guide to canning at home: what keeps canned food safe, then recipes for fruit, tomatoes, vegetables, meat and seafood, pickles, jams and jellies. Process times are checked against the printed tables.
